response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior/staff-level individual contributor with broad full-stack, systems, and open-source experience, but shows no evidence of executive-level leadership, team scaling from 10 to 30+, production multi-agent AI systems, fintech-infrastructure depth (credit, payment flows), or governance of regulated/high-stakes AI systems — all hard requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Broad, versatile technical background across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Some exposure to fintech-adjacent companies (Optilyz, RIDE Capital) and AI-agent tooling (MCP) at re:cinq
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source leadership, workshops/talks showing communication skills
concerns: No demonstrated executive or senior leadership experience managing/scaling teams (still IC-level titles like 'Senior/Staff Software Engineer')
No evidence of production multi-agent AI system design, agentic architecture, or LLM evaluation/orchestration at scale
No experience with regulated financial systems, credit risk, compliance/auditability, or governing outsourced engineering teams

key_factors.factor: Lack of executive/team-scaling leadership track record
No production multi-agent AI or agentic architecture experience
